transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well… I’m a little embarrassed to say it. I guess what finally made me come in is that sometimes after I eat too much, I’ve been going to the bathroom and making myself throw up so I won’t gain weight. I kept telling myself it was just a slip, you know, not a big deal… but it’s happened enough now that I got scared. I hope it’s okay to be honest about that.
How often have you been making yourself throw up after eating?

Um… I’d like to say it’s just once in a while, but that wouldn’t really be honest. For the past several months, it’s been most weeks that I have one of those secret eating spells and then I go make myself sick afterward. I know that probably sounds bad… I just can’t really call it occasional anymore.
Do you often restrict the amount or types of food you eat between those secret eating spells?

I’m not sure I’d call it “restricting,” exactly… I mean, I don’t have a strict plan or anything. Sometimes I try to be “good” after, like eat lighter or avoid certain things for a bit, but I don’t know if that’s what you mean. I may be making it sound better than it is… I’m just not totally sure how to answer.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight over the past few months?
Um… not anything dramatic, I don’t think. My clothes fit maybe a little differently some days, but I haven’t really been tracking it closely. I guess I’m not sure what would count as significant.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

I… yes, I think I am. I don’t like to say it that strongly, because it sounds vain, but if my skirt feels tight before church, or I see myself sideways in one of the store mirrors, it can just… spoil the whole day. I start thinking everyone can tell I’ve let myself go. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Are there times when you eat a large amount of food in a short period and don't make yourself throw up afterward?

Yes… there are times. I don’t always make myself throw up afterward, if that’s what you’re asking.

It’s usually not like a planned thing. After bridge night, or if I’ve had a late shift and I come home tired, I might start with just some leftover casserole… and then maybe the cookies I baked, crackers, ice cream. It ends up being much more than I would ever put on a plate in front of anyone. I feel embarrassed saying it that way, but… yes, it does happen.
How often do you eat a large amount of food in a short period without making yourself throw up afterward?

I’m not sure I could give you a good number. I don’t really write it down or anything… and some days I tell myself it wasn’t “large,” just more snacking than I meant to do.

Maybe it happens here and there, especially when I’m tired or alone, but I’d hate to exaggerate it. Do you mean like per week, or just generally?
Do you have these episodes of eating a large amount of food in a short period more than once a week?

More than once a week… I suppose, yes, some weeks it is. I don’t want to make it sound like I’m doing that every single night, but after bridge night or when I’ve worked late and come home worn out, I can end up eating a lot all at once—leftover casserole, then cookies, crackers, ice cream. More than I’d ever serve myself if someone were watching. So… yes, more than once a week can happen.
Is making yourself throw up mostly about trying to not gain weight after eating a lot?

Yes… mostly, yes. I don’t like admitting that, but after I eat too much I get scared about gaining weight, and I’ve been making myself throw up in the bathroom.

I kept telling myself it was just a one-time mistake, but it’s… it’s been happening enough that it scared me into coming in. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Do you make yourself throw up after almost every time you eat a large amount of food in a short period?

Almost every time… I don’t know if I should say it quite that strongly. But yes, after I eat too much, I’ve been going to the bathroom and making myself throw up because I’m scared I’ll gain weight.

It’s not just a one-time slip anymore, which is what finally worried me enough to come in. I’m sorry, I know that sounds bad.
Do you usually make yourself throw up immediately after eating a large amount of food in a short period?

Usually, yes… I mean, not to make it sound dramatic, but after I eat too much, I tend to go to the bathroom pretty soon after and make myself throw up because I’m scared I’ll gain weight.

That’s what finally scared me into coming in, honestly. It isn’t feeling like just a one-time mistake anymore. Is that what you were asking?
Do you make yourself throw up after every single time you eat a large amount of food in a short period?

Every single time… I don’t want to say that if it isn’t exactly true. But it’s been happening enough that it scared me. After I eat too much, I’ve been going to the bathroom and making myself throw up so I won’t gain weight.

I know that doesn’t sound good. I just don’t want to exaggerate, but it’s not a one-time mistake anymore.
